Title: Application loads successfully
Preconditions: User opens the app in a browser
Test Steps: 1. Launch the app. 2. Wait for the homepage to render.
Expected Result: Header is visible; Home page content renders; no blank screen or crash.

Title: Header navigation visible on all pages
Preconditions: User is on any valid page
Expected Result: GlobalTaste brand and links for Home, Search, Categories, Favorites, Planner, Basket, and Surprise Me are visible.

Title: Home navigation works
Expected Result: URL updates to home route; Home page heading and content display.
Actual Result: Home page displayed correctly after navigating from Search.
Notes: Verified manually on the deployed Netlify site.

Title: Search page navigation works
Expected Result: Search route opens; Search heading displays; user can search meals.

Title: Categories page navigation works
Expected Result: Categories route opens; category/cuisine view displays.
Actual Result: Categories page displayed correctly, and selecting a category displayed its meals.
Notes: Verified manually on the deployed Netlify site.

Title: Favorites page navigation works
Expected Result: Favorites route opens; saved items or empty state display.

Title: Planner page navigation works
Expected Result: Planner route opens; meal planning view displays.
Actual Result: Planner page loaded correctly and displayed the planner interface.
Notes: Verified manually on the deployed Netlify site.

Title: Basket page navigation works
Expected Result: Basket route opens; selected meals or empty state display.

Title: Surprise Me page navigation works
Expected Result: Surprise route opens; random meal suggestion displays.

Title: Meal Details page loads with meal ID
Expected Result: Meal Details heading appears; selected meal ID is displayed.

Title: Meal Details page handles missing ID gracefully
Preconditions: User navigates to a malformed detail route
Expected Result: No crash; fallback or empty state appears.

Title: Main layout persists across navigation
Expected Result: Header and footer remain visible; only main content changes.

Title: Footer content is present
Expected Result: Footer contains GlobalTaste branding and copyright text.
Actual Result: Footer was visible at the bottom of the tested pages.
Notes: Verified manually on the deployed Netlify site.

Title: Browser refresh works on route pages
Preconditions: User is on a route page such as /categories
Expected Result: App shell and selected route remain intact after reload.
Actual Result: All tested nested routes reloaded successfully on the deployed Netlify application without 404 errors.
Notes: Verified manually on the deployed Netlify site.

Title: Active navigation state works
Preconditions: User navigates to Search or another page
Expected Result: Current page link is visually highlighted.
Actual Result: The active navigation indicator changed correctly when moving between Home, Search, Categories and Planner.
Notes: Verified manually on the deployed Netlify site.

Title: Unknown route handling
Expected Result: Not-found page or safe redirect appears; no broken UI.

Title: Search input behavior works
Test Steps: 1. Type a meal keyword into search field.
Expected Result: Input accepts text and shows entered value for search/filtering.

Title: Favorite action can be triggered
Preconditions: User opens a meal result or detail
Expected Result: Favorite state toggles and meal is saved to favorites.

Title: Meal selection opens details
Preconditions: User is on a meal list or card
Expected Result: User is redirected to the meal detail route with correct meal data.

Title: Surprise feature returns a valid recommendation
Expected Result: A valid meal suggestion is returned and displayed.

Title: No results returned from search
Preconditions: User searches for a non-matching keyword
Test Steps: 1. Enter a keyword with no results.
Expected Result: Empty-state message displays; app remains stable.

Title: Duplicate favorites prevented
Test Steps: 1. Add the same meal to favorites twice.
Expected Result: Meal appears only once in favorites list.

Title: Basket empty state
Expected Result: Meaningful empty-state message is displayed.

Title: Meal detail loading state handles delay
Preconditions: Slow API response for meal details
Expected Result: Loading indicator appears while data is pending.

Title: Invalid meal ID handled gracefully
Preconditions: User navigates to an invalid meal ID
Test Steps: 1. Visit a meal route with an unknown ID.
Expected Result: User sees a meaningful error or not-found message; app remains stable.

Title: Registration validation and duplicate account prevention
Test Steps: Register valid details; repeat with same email; try invalid email and short password.
Expected Result: Valid registration succeeds; duplicate and invalid registrations are rejected.
Notes: Verified by backend automated tests; full backend suite: 89 passed.

Title: Login with valid and invalid credentials
Test Steps: Log in with valid credentials, then an incorrect password.
Expected Result: Valid credentials authenticate; invalid credentials are rejected.
Notes: Verified by backend automated tests; full backend suite: 89 passed.

Title: Protected API endpoints reject unauthenticated requests
Test Steps: Request profile, favorites, planner and basket endpoints without a token.
Expected Result: Protected endpoints reject unauthenticated requests.
Notes: Verified by backend automated tests; full backend suite: 89 passed.

Title: User data is isolated between accounts
Test Steps: Add private data as account A; inspect and attempt access as account B.
Expected Result: Each account can access and modify only its own private data.
Notes: Verified by backend automated tests; full backend suite: 89 passed.

Title: Admin endpoints enforce role-based access
Preconditions: Admin and normal user test credentials available
Test Steps: Access admin endpoints without a token, as a normal user and as an admin.
Expected Result: Unauthenticated requests are rejected; normal users are forbidden; admins are allowed.
Notes: Verified by backend automated tests; full backend suite: 89 passed.

Title: Admin can create, view, update and delete admin meals
Test Steps: Create, retrieve, update and delete an admin meal.
Expected Result: Authorized CRUD operations succeed.
Notes: Verified by backend automated tests; full backend suite: 89 passed.

Title: Tampered and expired JWT tokens are rejected
Test Steps: Modify a token and submit an expired token to protected endpoints.
Expected Result: Invalid or expired tokens do not grant access.
Actual Result: Automated tests passed: test_expired_token_gets_a_clear_401 and test_tampered_token_is_rejected.
Notes: Covered by the security test suite; 74 security tests passed.

Title: Logout and browser session behavior
Preconditions: User can log in to the frontend
Test Steps: Log in, refresh, visit protected pages, log out and revisit protected pages.
Expected Result: Session behavior matches the implemented authentication design; logged-out users cannot access protected resources as authenticated users.
Actual Result: API tests passed: test_logout_revokes_the_token, test_logout_only_ends_that_session and test_logout_requires_a_token. Browser-level session behaviour remains unverified.
Notes: Complete manual browser session checks before marking fully passed.

Title: CORS permits only configured frontend origins
Test Steps: Send requests with an allowed origin and an unconfigured origin.
Expected Result: Cross-origin access follows the configured CORS policy.
Actual Result: Production HTTP checks: Netlify origin allowed; OPTIONS preflight returned 200 with required headers; example.com received no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header.
Notes: Verified against deployed Render API on 2026-11-01 using curl. Browser-based CORS testing not performed.

Title: Malformed JSON and unsupported content types
Test Steps: Submit malformed JSON and unsupported content types.
Expected Result: Requests are rejected safely without exposing internal details.
Actual Result: Malformed JSON rejection passed test_malformed_json_is_rejected; unsupported content types remain unverified.
Notes: Automated malformed-JSON test passed; verify unsupported content types separately.

Title: SQL injection-style input handling
Preconditions: Search and text input endpoints available
Test Steps: Submit SQL injection-style strings in relevant input fields.
Expected Result: Inputs are treated as data; no unauthorized access or data modification occurs.
Notes: Use non-destructive test inputs.

Title: Oversized request payload handling
Test Steps: Submit a request body larger than the configured limit.
Expected Result: Oversized requests are rejected safely.
Notes: Confirm configured limit before testing.

Title: Custom meal CRUD and ownership
Preconditions: Custom meal implementation merged; test database initialized.
Test Steps: Create, view, update and delete a custom meal; attempt access as another user.
Expected Result: Owners manage their own meals; other users cannot access or modify private meals.
Notes: Backend tests cover CRUD and ownership; verify frontend workflow and production migration separately.

Title: Custom meal visibility
Preconditions: Custom meal implementation merged; test database initialized.
Test Steps: Create private and public meals; inspect as owner, another user and guest.
Expected Result: Public and private visibility follow the implemented access rules.
Notes: Backend visibility test passed; verify the frontend experience separately.
